items.title: Huge crunch-time minutes from Baylor Scheierman.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Huge crunch-time minutes from Baylor Scheierman.

He knocks down a pair of 3s and gets an offensive rebound.

Scheierman is also helping on the defensive glass: 2 rebounds at that end. 

The Celtics entered the night ranked 28th in DReb%. They've only given up 1 OReb in the 4th.

items.title: Baylor Scheierman the closer tonight, huh?
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Baylor Scheierman the closer tonight, huh?

Eight straight points for Scheierman with two triples sandwiched around a couple of free throws.

Looks like the Celtics are going to survive.

Baylor Scheierman has become so important to the Celtics rotation, that I'd like to see them get him of the floor.

That would mean putting Mike Conley in, and that usually doesn't happen to a vet in a blowout.

items.title: Don't take NBA dot com's matchup data as gospel, but it has Michael Porter Jr. as only getting 3 points and 1 shot attempt when guarded by Baylor Scheierman last night.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Don't take NBA dot com's matchup data as gospel, but it has Michael Porter Jr. as only getting 3 points and 1 shot attempt when guarded by Baylor Scheierman last night.

In particular, I thought Scheierman did a good job of denying MPJ off the ball, forcing the Nets to look elsewhere.
